luminary_visionary.title: The Luminary Visionary
luminary_visionary.traits: Driven, intuitive, highly creative, strategic, magnetic leader.
luminary_visionary.description: Combines a sharp Head Line with fiery Tarot influences. Capable of spearheading innovative movements and inspiring communities.

mystic_healer.title: The Mystic Healer
mystic_healer.traits: Profound empathy, psychic sensitivity, grounded nurture, calm aura.
mystic_healer.description: Grounded by deep Life & Heart lines with high Water element tarot alignment. Deeply attuned to human emotions and energetic subtle states.

sovereign_strategist.title: The Sovereign Strategist
sovereign_strategist.traits: Disciplined execution, formidable logic, structural integrity, unwavering persistence.
sovereign_strategist.description: Features a prominent Fate line and square hand architecture. Thrives when establishing sustainable wealth, order, and high efficiency.

catalyst_pioneer.title: The Catalyst Pioneer
catalyst_pioneer.description: Marked by branched life lines and active major arcana draws. Unlocks breakthroughs in fast-changing environments.
